verdict.rationale: Wrike's own marketing pages say users can configure and tailor personalized dashboards to track work, and can view real-time reports in visual dashboards. Together these cover the core of building dashboards to report on project progress. missing for 10: explicit documentation of widget types and configuration, in-depth first-party dashboard docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can build dashboards and widgets to report on project progress

citations.quote: Configure and tailor personalized dashboard to help track the work you need to see.
